sentences.text: 2. The second respondent gave a complaint to the first respondent on the ground that she had a love affair with the petitioner and the petitioner on a false promise to marry, had physical relationship with the second respondent.
Ultimately, the petitioner started evading the second respondent and refused to marry her.
Based on this complaint, an FIR came to be registered in Crime No.260 of 2020 by the first respondent.
On completion of investigation, a Police report has been filed before the learned District Munsif cum Judicial Magistrate, Kadaladi, for the offences under Sections 417 and 376 of IPC.

entities.text: District Munsif cum Judicial Magistrate, Kadaladi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The Court below has taken cognizance of the offence and the case has been taken on file in P.R.C.No.05 of 2022.
Aggrieved by the same, the present Quash Petition has been filed before this Court.
3. Heard the learned counsel on either side. https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis Crl.O.P.(MD).No.16346 of 2022 4.
The submissions were made touching upon the merits of the case and also on the ground that even if the materials are taken as it is, no offence has been made out against the petitioner.
5. It is not necessary for this Court to go into the issue on merits and this Court finds that the Court below has taken rubber stamp cognizance of the Police report filed by the first respondent.

For proper appreciation, the Cognizance Order is scanned and extracted hereunder:
6.
This Court by relying upon the judgment of the Honble Apex Court has repeatedly held that the process of taking cognizance is a judicial process which requires application of mind.
A rubber stamp cognizance is no cognizance in the eye of law since what is being done is to put the seal in the complaint and fill-up the gaps.
Such rubber stamp https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis Crl.O.P.(MD).No.16346 of 2022 cognizance has been frowned upon by this Court.
Useful reference can be made to the judgment of this Court in Shanmugam and others v. Inspector of Police, Ariyalur Police Station, Ariyalur and others, reported in (2019) 3 MLJ (Crl.) 339.

opennyai_summary.decision:
In view of the above, the rubber stamp cognizance taken by the Court below is hereby set aside.
The matter is remitted back to the file of the learned District Munsif cum Judicial Magistrate,
Kadaladi and the learned Judicial Magistrate shall apply his mind on the allegations made in the complaint and the materials relied upon and pass appropriate orders which must reflect the application of mind.
This process shall be complied within a period of four weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
In the result, this Criminal Original Petition is allowed in the above terms.
